---
title: "GitHub Extension For Quarto"
subtitle: "Quarto Extension"
author:
  - name: "Mickaël CANOUIL, _Ph.D._"
    orcid: "0000-0002-3396-4549"
    url: "https://mickael.canouil.fr"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
filters:
  # post-quarto is required, so Quarto resolves its own cross-references first.
  - path: github
    at: post-quarto
extensions:
  github:
    repository-name: jlord/sheetsee.js
    base-url: https://github.com
---

> This extension is superseded by [Git Link](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-gitlink).

References are written as they would be in a GitHub comment, and the filter turns them into links.

```markdown
Fixed in #26 and in jlord/sheetsee.js#26 as well
```

Fixed in #26 and in jlord/sheetsee.js#26 as well.

A full URL is shortened: https://github.com/jlord/sheetsee.js/issues/26 .

Mentions work too, for people and organisations: @mcanouil and @quarto-dev .

A reference has to be followed by a space, so `#26,` and `#26.` are left as plain text.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-github/>.
